binh.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now soft sage green instead of red. Her face and pose: serene calm face, eyes gently closed, a soft closed-mouth smile, holding a small pale celadon teacup in both hands at chest height, one thin wisp of tea steam. Light posture only: shoulders relaxed, head tilted a little; exactly two hands, no big gesture. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
binh.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed soft sage green medallion as the reference. NEW: she is CALM and serene and leans slightly OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come a little forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; small calm gesture only, no big arms, no waving, no extra hands; both hands holding a small pale celadon teacup just over the gold rim; eyes gently closed, soft closed-mouth smile; one thin wisp of tea steam. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
binh.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion feels at peace: she leans a little forward over the gold rim holding a small celadon teacup in both hands, closes her eyes with a soft serene smile, a thin wisp of tea steam rises; she comes out of the round frame only a little toward the viewer. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, no big arms, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
binh.loop: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green. The young consort with the gold hairpins leaning slightly out of the round gold medallion stays calm in a slow loop: she raises the small teacup a little, takes a tiny sip with eyes closed, lowers it with a serene smile, the thin tea steam curls softly; then she settles back to exactly the starting pose. Small calm movements only, exactly two hands, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Slow enough to read, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
